answer: Make voting weight inseparable from a slowly matured custody record. Each identity must keep one unique marble on deposit through several clean settlement windows before it can countersign invoices; forking the key ejects every copy and restarts the wait. That deposit is the only public anchor counterparties will pay against. When a burst of new keys retells the same founding fable, shares timing, or emits near-copied work, bill them as one renter and slash the cluster, so a farm pays rent rather than buying extra votes.
